features.title: /btw side chat
features.summary: /btw <question> forks the thread at its latest completed turn with the same model and route, asks the question there, and opens the fork in a right-sidebar tab where follow-ups continue. The fork is hidden from the thread sidebar and archived when its tab closes; the tab header shows how much of the first request the provider read from its prefix cache.
failureModes: A refused fork creates nothing; a failure after the fork archives it and shows why in the tab.
A side chat from before a reload has no flow left; closing its tab still archives it.

verification.testName: forks, pins the source route, opens the panel, asks, and archives on close
archives the fork when asking fails, and reports why
reads the first request after the fork seed, not the copied source requests

features.title: Persisted /btw command chip
features.summary: A draft whose leading token is /btw persists as a command chip: the composer's restore path resolves the claim through the trigger pipeline's matchClaim (the /btw source answers the same claim matchEnter would), so a reload rebuilds the chip with its hint instead of throwing inside a client-store subscriber and leaving literal text behind.
failureModes: A trigger pipeline without matchClaim/resolveClaim throws on every draft seed and never rebuilds the chip.
A source that would act on the token instead of only answering the claim runs its action during a restore.

verification.testName: answers a persisted /btw chip with its claim and performs nothing

features.title: Open a side question from the palette, a shortcut or the composer
features.summary: Besides /btw, three ways open one “Ask a side question” dialog for the thread, which forks it as /btw does: the command palette action “Ask a side question (btw)” (for the open, unarchived thread); the btw.askSideQuestion shortcut (default Mod+Alt+/, rebindable in Settings › Shortcuts, for the thread in the main view; it registers unbound when another command owns the chord); and an icon-only button in the composer's right toolbar before Prompts, which carries no label so the composer's collapse order is unchanged and hides on a blank draft.
reach: fill textbox "Describe what you want to build, / commands, @ files or sessions" "Side question thread"
failureModes: A refused fork keeps the dialog open with the reason and creates nothing to archive.
A conflicting default chord leaves the command listed without a binding.
On a panel, the New thread screen or a blank draft there is nothing to fork: the action is hidden and the chord passes through.

verification.testName: reports success once the fork is configured, before the answer arrives
reports why a refused fork started nothing
picks the thread the main view retains, skipping side panes and blank drafts
has no target on a panel or the New thread screen
